theme: Three days of choosing joy — practicing the muscle of delight

days.task: Do one thing today with zero productivity value — only because it makes you happy. Write what it was.
List 5 moments from the last 7 days that had genuine joy in them. Even small. Even brief. Write them.
Bring one playful or joyful element into something ordinary today — a work task, a commute, a meal. Write what changed.
